dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 mainframe program, part of the IBM CICS TS sample application (LOANAPP/General Insurance). Uses EXEC CICS and EXEC SQL with DB2 IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() and SQLCA. Copyright IBM Corp. 2011-2021.

purpose.domain_detail: General insurance policy management system (IBM CICS TS sample application). Handles adding new insurance policies: Endowment, House, Motor, Commercial, and Claims.
purpose.summary: LGAPDB01 is a CICS online subprogram that inserts new insurance policy records into DB2 tables. It receives policy details via a COMMAREA, validates the request type, inserts into the POLICY table and the appropriate policy-type-specific table (ENDOWMENT, HOUSE, MOTOR, COMMERCIAL, or CLAIM), then links to LGAPVS01 for further processing.

notable_features: EXEC SQL (DB2) with INSERT, SELECT, SET IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL()
EXEC CICS (CICS TS) with RETURN, ABEND, Link
SQLCA included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE
DFHCOMMAREA defined via EXEC SQL INCLUDE LGCMAREA
Varying-length VARCHAR field handling (WS-VARY-FIELD with 49-level items)
Multiple policy type dispatch via EVALUATE CA-REQUEST-ID
Error message writing with SQLCODE capture
No COPY statements (copybooks included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE)
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; the INSERT-ENDOW section and subsequent sections (INSERT-HOUSE, INSERT-MOTOR, INSERT-COMMERCIAL, INSERT-CLAIM, WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE) are cut off. This is clearly the IBM CICS TS General Insurance sample application distributed with IBM CICS Transaction Server.
